balance_not_confirmed.en: the balance couldn't be confirmed from the documents

no_balance_anchor.en: no balance appears on the documents; statements showing balances were requested
no_balance_anchor.text: 서류에 잔액이 나타나 있지 않아 잔액이 표시된 명세서를 요청했습니다

signature_authority_only.en: the account is held by someone else and the client can sign on it
signature_authority_only.text: 타인 명의의 계좌이며 고객님께서 서명 권한을 보유하고 있습니다

possible_intraday_peak.en: a same-day deposit and withdrawal were checked against the highest balance
possible_intraday_peak.text: 당일 입금 및 출금을 최고 잔액과 대조하여 확인했습니다

account_number_masked.en: rows with a partly masked account number were matched to the client's accounts
account_number_masked.text: 계좌번호가 일부 가려진 내역을 고객님의 계좌와 대조했습니다

arithmetic_mismatch.en: a printed balance was checked against the transactions
arithmetic_mismatch.text: 표기된 잔액을 거래 내역과 대조하여 확인했습니다

continuity_break.en: the balances between two statements were checked
continuity_break.text: 두 명세서 간의 잔액을 대조하여 확인했습니다

coverage_gap.en: some days of the year are not covered by a statement
coverage_gap.text: 연중 일부 날짜가 명세서로 확인되지 않습니다

institution_names_differ.en: the bank name differs between statements and was checked

currency_conflict.en: the currency shown on the statements was checked

currency_unknown.en: the account's currency was checked against the Treasury exchange rates
currency_unknown.text: 계좌의 통화를 미국 재무부 환율과 대조하여 확인했습니다
currency_unknown.model_text: 계좌의 통화를 재무부 환율과 대조하여 확인했습니다

ownership_unknown.en: who owns the account was confirmed with the client

field_unreadable.en: a part of a statement that couldn't be read was checked
field_unreadable.text: 명세서 중 판독이 불가능한 부분을 확인했습니다

no_statements.en: no statement was received for this account; statements were requested
no_statements.text: 이 계좌에 대한 명세서가 접수되지 않아 명세서를 요청했습니다

page_not_read.en: a page that couldn't be read was checked
